adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then uses `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)`. This allows `offset` to be negative (e.g. "-10" -> -10), which can produce an invalid SQL `OFFSET -10` and error. It also allows a non-numeric `limit` to become `0` (e.g. "abc".to_i -> 0), and the client computes `currentPage`/`totalPages` by dividing by `limit` in `admin-group.js.es6` (`Math.floor(user_count / limit)` and `Math.floor(offset / limit)`), which will break (division by zero/infinite pages) if the server returns `meta.limit: 0`.
